cli.usage:
Usage: charet <command> [options]

Get started:
  setup [--yes]                  First-run guide: server check, admin link, skill install
  doctor                         Check node, git, the server and its services
  serve [--server-only]          Run charet-server (with charet-workspace and charet-render)
  skill install [--claude] [--codex]
                                 Install the charet skill for coding agents
  login [--token t]              Sign in to a shared charet with the token an admin gave you
  logout                         Forget the token on this machine
  whoami                         Who the CLI acts as

Projects:
  projects                       List projects
  delete <project> [--yes]       Delete a project with its versions, captures and comments
  init <key> [dir] [--template recommended] [--title t]
                                 Create a project from a template and check it out
  import [path] [--key k] [--title t] [--include dir]... [--dry-run]
                                 Import an app (and the workspace packages it uses) as a project
  checkout <project> [dir] [--rev main|vN] [--branch N]
                                 Download a project (or one branch) into a folder
  status                         Base, latest version and local changes of this checkout
  push [-m message] [--merge]    Send changes: from main a new branch (a draft), else to its branch
                                 (--merge: merge it right away and come back to main)
  pull                           Update this checkout to the latest of its branch or main
  dev                            Run the app's dev server in this checkout
  versions                       List versions
  diff <from> [to]               List paths changed between versions
  restore vN                     A new version that undoes vN

Product repo (admins):
  handoff [status]               Baseline, what to hand off, and (inside the repo) its changes
  handoff export [--since vN] [--with-mocks] [--out f]
                                 Patch of main since the baseline, for `git apply`
  handoff mark vN [--commit sha] Mark vN as in the product repo (default: HEAD here)
  import --update [path]         Bring the product repo's files in again as a version

Branches:
  branches [--all]               Drafts and branches in review (--all: merged and archived too)
  branch [n]                     One branch: changes, clashes, history
  branch review|approve|merge|archive|reopen|duplicate|catch-up [n]
                                 Ask for review, approve protected files (admin), merge into
                                 main, close, bring back, copy as your own, or take in main

Structure:
  ls [--stale]                   Screens, stories and flows (--stale: ids that need a capture)
  show <id>                      A screen, story, page, flow, component or comment (c12)
  url [id]                       Link to it in the web tool
  connections [--from s] [--to s] [--page p]
                                 Transitions between screens
  path <from> <to> [--sheet f.jpg]
                                 How a user gets from one screen to another
  map [--format text|mermaid]    Pages, screens and connections
  flows | flow <id> [--sheet f.jpg]
                                 Flows and their steps (planned ones too)
  sheet <id>... --out f.jpg      Captures side by side in one picture
  source <path[:line]|id> [--context n]
                                 A file of main, or the files a screen renders from

Check and capture:
  check [id...] [--theme light|dark|both]
                                 Open pages and report errors, console errors, missing mocks
  capture [id...] [--theme ...] [--force] [--out dir]
                                 Update what the web tool shows (and move comment pins)

Comments:
  comments [--all|--resolved] [--on id] [--branch N]
                                 List comments (exit 1 while some are open)
  comments show <c12> [--out dir]
  comments add <id> --at x,y|selector -m text [--theme dark]
  comments reply|resolve|reopen <c12> [-m text]
  inbox [--all]                  Your notifications (new comments and answers)
  inbox read [id...]             Mark them read (all when no id)

Options: -p <project> (or run inside a checkout), --server <url> (or CHARET_URL), --json, --version
cli.projects.none: No projects yet. Import one with `charet import <path>`.
cli.import.plan: Would import {count} files as project {key} from {source}:
cli.import.planMore: (folders and root files shown; --json lists every file)
cli.handoff.noBaseline: none (not imported from a product repo)
cli.handoff.pending: to hand off: {files} file(s) (versions not in the repo yet: {versions})
cli.handoff.noRepo: not found here; run this inside the product repo to see its changes
cli.handoff.noRepoCommit: unknown: the baseline has no repo commit (run `charet import --update` once)
cli.handoff.unknownCommit: unknown: {commit} is not in this repository (fetch it, or check the clone)
cli.handoff.noDrift: none: the repo has not changed the imported files since the baseline
cli.handoff.drift: the repo changed the imported files since the baseline ({commits} commit(s), {files} uncommitted). Bring them in with `charet import --update`.
cli.handoff.exportNothing: Nothing to hand off: v{to} has no product changes since v{from}.
cli.handoff.exportSummary: Patch from v{from} to v{to}: {files} file(s), for the repo at {repo}.
cli.handoff.exported: Wrote the patch from v{from} to v{to} ({files} file(s), for the repo at {repo}) to {file}.
cli.handoff.next: Next: in the product repo, `git apply {file}` on a work branch, check, open a PR; once merged, `charet handoff mark v{to} --commit <sha>`.
cli.handoff.needCommit: Which product repo commit has it? Pass --commit <sha>, or run this inside the product repo.
cli.handoff.marked: Marked v{version} (and every version before it) as in the product repo at {commit}.
cli.handoff.noRepoFor: Cannot find the imported app ({app}) here: run this inside the product repo, or pass its path.
cli.import.updatePlan: Would bring {count} files from {source} into project {key} as a new import version.
cli.import.updated: Brought {count} files in from the product repo as version {version}. Open branches catch up on their own.
cli.import.updateClash: The product repo and merged work not handed off yet both changed {files}. Hand that work off first (`charet handoff export`), or settle it in the repo, then import again.
cli.usage.handoff: Usage: charet handoff [status] | charet handoff export [--since vN] [--with-mocks] [--out file] | charet handoff mark vN [--commit sha]
cli.push.nothing: Nothing to push: no changes since the last push.
cli.push.conflict: Someone pushed first. Set aside your changes, run `charet pull`, then push again.
cli.pull.dirty: This checkout has unpushed changes. Push them first.
cli.error.noProject: Which project? Pass -p <project> or run inside a checkout.
cli.error.noCheckout: Not inside a checkout. Run `charet checkout <project>` first.
cli.error.unreachable: Cannot reach the charet server. Is it running? (set CHARET_URL or --server)
cli.error.signIn: Sign in: on the machine that runs charet, `charet setup` (as its owner); elsewhere `charet login --token <token>` with the token an admin gave you.

web.team.title: Team
cli.login.badToken: The server did not accept this token.

web.access.title: Who can see it
web.access.teamLead: Everyone with a token sees the project; visitors as set below.
web.access.privateLead: Only the people picked below and admins see it.
web.presence.presenting: {name} is presenting — you follow their view
web.presence.spotlightHint: Everyone here follows your view until they step away
cli.usage.inbox: Usage: charet inbox [--all] | charet inbox read [id...]
cli.inbox.noneUnread: No unread notifications (charet inbox --all shows earlier ones).
cli.inbox.unread: {count} unread. charet inbox read marks them read.
web.inbox.title: Notifications
web.inbox.empty: Nothing yet. New comments and answers in your threads show up here.
web.webhooks.title: Webhooks
web.webhooks.allProjects: All projects that are not private
web.webhooks.empty: No webhooks. Add one to post comments and versions to Slack, CI or your own service.
web.webhooks.secretOnce: Copy the signing secret now; it is not shown again. Receivers check X-Charet-Signature with it.
cli.doctor.https: Tokens travel with every request: put charet behind a fixed HTTPS address (e.g. an ngrok domain) and set CHARET_PUBLIC_URL to it.
cli.doctor.previewsShared: web tool and previews on {url} (previews served sandboxed)
web.sharing.title: Sharing
web.sharing.lead: Other machines come in through an address you set up: a reverse proxy or tunnel to {target}. Members bring their token; others are visitors.
web.sharing.onLead: Links (team tokens, notifications) now use this address.
web.sharing.lead.tailscale: People on your tailnet (Tailscale or Headscale) open this machine's name. Nothing is reachable from the internet.
web.sharing.lead.funnel: Anyone with the address reaches this machine's ts.net name. Members bring their token; others are visitors (or need a token, see Visitors).
web.sharing.lead.ngrok: This server runs the ngrok tunnel itself. Anyone with the address reaches this server; members bring their token. A free ngrok account works.
web.sharing.ngrokSaved: Saved (…{last}); leave empty to keep it
web.sharing.lead.lan: People on the same network open this machine's IP address over plain HTTP. For trying things out; links show the IP.
cli.doctor.sharedUnreachable: shared at {url}, but that address does not answer
cli.doctor.sharedHint: Check the tunnel or proxy points at the remote door (127.0.0.1:5284), or pick another way in Team › Sharing.
web.firstRun.title: Just installed charet?
web.firstRun.body: You are looking as a visitor. To come in as the admin, open the admin link printed in the terminal where you started the server. Either command prints it again:
web.auth.tokenRequired: This server needs a token to look around.
web.auth.replaced: Your token was used on another browser, so this one was signed out.
web.auth.tokenLead: Paste the token an admin gave you. This browser stays signed in.
web.auth.badToken: That token does not work. Ask your admin for the current one.
web.visitor.name: {adjective} {animal}
web.team.lead: Add people with a role and hand over their token (or a link that carries it). Anyone with a member's token acts as them.
web.team.name: Name
web.team.reissueHint: The old token stops working and their browsers are signed out.
web.team.visitorsLead: People without a token come in under a made-up name and do what this allows. A project can set its own level (Access on the project).
web.access.viewOnly: You can view this project but not comment.
cli.login.needToken: Give the token an admin handed over: charet login --token <token> (or set CHARET_TOKEN).
cli.checkout.branch: Checked out branch #{number} of {project} at {commit} into {dir}
cli.push.branch: Pushed {count} changed files to branch #{number} (this checkout now follows it). Review: {url} · merge it with `charet branch merge`.
cli.merge.approval: Branch #{number} changes protected files ({files}); an admin has to approve them: `charet branch approve {number}`.
cli.merge.checkFailed: Merging branch #{number} would bring new problems; fix them on the branch, push, then merge:{issues}
cli.branch.approve: Approved the protected-file changes of branch #{number}.
cli.merge.clash: Branch #{number} clashes with main in {files}. Run `charet branch catch-up`, settle those files, push, then merge.
cli.pull.closed: Branch #{number} is {status}; this checkout is back on main at {commit}.
cli.branches.none: No open branches. `charet push` in a checkout of main starts one.
cli.branch.which: Which branch? Give its number, or run this in a branch checkout.
cli.branch.duplicate: Branch #{number} copies #{from} as your own draft: `charet checkout <project> --branch {number}`.
cli.branch.caughtUp: Branch #{number} caught up with main. Run `charet pull` to get it here.
cli.branch.clash: Branch #{number} clashes with main in {files}: settle them on the branch and push.
cli.restore.clash: Undoing v{version} clashes with later changes in {files}; fix them in a branch instead.
web.branches.title: Branches
web.branches.none: No open branches. A `charet push` from a checkout of main starts one.
web.branches.how: A branch is a change on top of main: a draft while its author works, then up for review. Merging it makes a new version.
web.branch.clash: These files changed on main too; settle them on the branch before merging:
web.branch.mix: How much of the new version shows
web.branch.tooLarge: This file is too large to compare line by line.
web.branch.protected: Changes protected files (installs and build settings); an admin has to approve them. Until then previews use main's:
web.branch.needsApproval: An admin has to approve the protected files first
web.branch.checking: Checking what merging gives: building it…
web.branch.checkPassed: The merged result builds and its screens open cleanly.
web.branch.checkFailed: Merging would bring new problems; fix them on the branch first:
web.branch.pickSpot: Click a spot on the new screen to comment on it.
web.branch.commentPlaceholder: Comment on this spot of the branch…
web.branch.event.duplicate: started it as a copy of
web.versions.restore: Restore v{number}: a new version that undoes it
web.team.visitorsNote: Looking covers screens, flows, code and comments. Downloading the whole project (charet checkout) always needs a token.
web.access.visitorsOwn: This project's own setting, whatever the server says.
web.agent.title: Agent
web.agent.editorsOnly: Editors can ask the agent for changes.
web.agent.noKey: An admin can add an API key in Team › Web agent.
web.agent.lead: Say what to change. The agent works on a draft branch; every change it saves shows up there, and the team reviews it before it is merged.
web.agent.queued: Waiting for the run before it…
web.agent.imageLimit: Up to 4 images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) of 5 MB each.
web.agent.placeholder: What should change? E.g. “Make this button say Save and put it on the right”
web.agent.newDraftNote: Starts a new draft named after your request.
web.agent.closed: This branch is closed; its conversation is kept here.
web.agentAdmin.title: Web agent
web.agentAdmin.lead: Members ask for changes in the web tool and a coding agent makes them on a draft. Keys are stored encrypted and shown only by their last 4 characters.
web.agentAdmin.unpricedHint: Runs on a model without a known price (set CHARET_AGENT_PRICES on charet-agent).
cli.setup.noOwnerToken: Not signed in to {server}. Get the admin token with `docker compose exec server charet-server admin-token` (or `charet-server admin-token`), then `charet login --token <token>` and open {server}/?t=<token> in the browser.
web.design.title: Design
web.design.lead: Click an element on the screen to change its text, variant, spacing or order by hand. Every change is saved on a draft and checked; one that breaks a screen is taken back.
web.design.noSource: This element has no place in the code to edit. It comes from a package, or the app uses an @charet/sdk older than hand edits.
web.design.noText: No text of its own here.
web.design.noOrder: Its place is computed, or it has no siblings.
web.design.inList: In a list: this changes every item.
web.design.changedSince: Someone changed this file since; undo is not possible.
